label: GO step in the last ~10 trials of the episode (end-of-episode clock)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass); never at D1 or D2. Within GO it is an episode-time clock: rate is ~0 for trials 20-69, rises from trial ~75, and ~79% of GO steps in trials 90-99 are active (88% of activation mass). Precision rises with lateness (ep_trial>=95: precision 0.92), so magnitude grows toward the episode end. It tracks the model value head going down at the end of the episode (value<5.22 gives a similar F1 of 0.74): fewer trials left means less return to come. Small extras: the first trials of the episode (ep_trial 1-2) and GO steps after a D1 fixation error / penalty (in_rew=-1). Prev reward, choice, state, transition and the good state barely change the rate. Missed activations are mostly weak ones at trials 80-89. Uses only observed variables (episode time).
